sentences.text: This is the repeat (second) application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. for grant of bail relating to FIR/Crime No.129/2023 registered at P.S. Majholi, District Sidhi (M.P.) for the offence punishable under Sections 366A, 376 (3), 376 (2)(n), 450 of IPC and 5l, 5n, 6 of POCSO Act.
The applicant is in custody since 15.02.2023.
His first bail application was dismissed as withdrawn vide order dated 05.04.2023 in M.Cr.C. No.12144/2023.
The allegation against the present applicant is that he committed rape over a period of time with minor prosecutrix, who was only 16 years of age at the time of incident.

Learned counsel for the applicant has filed depositions of the prosecutrix as well as her mother on record to show that the prosecutrix as well as her mother have retracted their earlier statements and Deepak Kumar Kushwaha vs State Of M.P. on 20 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/104249081/
1 have not made any allegation against the present applicant, further they admitted that prosecutrix was major at the time of incident.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: On these premises, it is prayed that the applicant may be enlarged on bail.
A perusal of the evidence of prosecutrix as well as her mother show that they have not supported the prosecution story.
The MLC report is on record, however, the FSL report is not available on record.
Considering that the prosecutrix and her mother have turned hostile and not supported the prosecution story, this application is allowed.

It is directed that applicant be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with two sureties in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court/committal Court for his appearance on the dates given by the concerned Court.
It is further directed that the applicant shall also comply with the provisions of Section 437(3) of Cr.P.C.

In case, if the applicant is found involved in any other offence during the pendency of the trial then this bail order shall stand cancelled automatically and the authority concerned will be at liberty to take him into custody.
